verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a Review Hub with merge-readiness scoring (tests, linting, a11y, typecheck), plain-English summaries with diffs, and a review.md code-standards skill. None of it documents automatic AI review of every pull request that posts inline comments. These are adjacent review aids, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can have every pull request automatically reviewed with AI-generated inline comments
